items.text: Among children aged 2 to 17 discharged after an asthma admission from 2022 to 2025, is a complete five-section written action plan, compared with an incomplete plan, associated with a lower rate of asthma emergency revisit or readmission at any provincial hospital within 90 days, after adjustment for age, previous admissions, admission severity, controller at discharge and neighbourhood income?
items.population: Children aged 2 to 17, first asthma discharge per child in 2022 to 2025
items.intervention: Complete plan (five of five sections) at discharge (exposure)
items.outcome: First asthma emergency visit or readmission at any hospital in the province
items.setting: 190-bed children's hospital with provincial emergency visit linkage

finer: Feasible from scanned plans and linked provincial data within the analyst's time if the data sharing agreement is signed; interesting to the pathway team and the funding committee; novel for this template and population; ethical as secondary use under an approved waiver; relevant because it decides the electronic plan funding.
summary: One PECO question with a 90-day window and a pre-specified adjustment set.
